WITH RECURSIVE
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT t.id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id

current_set_inventories AS (

        ON ci.set_num = s.set_num

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.root_set_num,
        ci.inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * ns.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets ns
        ON ns.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_set_inventories ci
        ON ci.set_num = ns.set_num

WITH RECURSIVE gear_themes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Gear'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT t.id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN gear_themes g ON t.parent_id = g.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN gear_themes g ON s.theme_id = g.id
    WHERE s.year = 2013
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT set_num, id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            set_num,
            id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY set_num
                ORDER BY version DESC, id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
set_nodes(root_set_num, set_num, quantity, path) AS (
    SELECT
        set_num,
        set_num,
        1,
        array[set_num]
    FROM target_sets

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        n.root_set_num,
        ins.set_num,
        n.quantity * ins.quantity,
        array_append(n.path, ins.set_num)
    FROM set_nodes n
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = n.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE NOT array_contains(n.path, ins.set_num)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n.quantity * im.quantity), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM set_nodes n
JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = n.set_num
JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id;

WITH RECURSIVE current_lines AS (
    -- Use the highest inventory version of each set/minifig and exclude spare parts
    SELECT
        parent_kind,
        parent_num,
        child_kind,
        child_num
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            RANK() OVER (
                PARTITION BY parent_kind, parent_num
                ORDER BY version DESC
            ) AS version_rank
        FROM u_composition
    )
    WHERE version_rank = 1
      AND COALESCE(is_spare, FALSE) = FALSE
),
reachable AS (
    -- Everything directly or indirectly contained in each set's current inventory
    SELECT
        parent_kind AS root_kind,
        parent_num  AS root_num,
        child_kind  AS item_kind,
        child_num   AS item_num
    FROM current_lines
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'

    UNION

    SELECT
        r.root_kind,
        r.root_num,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num
    FROM reachable r
    JOIN current_lines c
        ON c.parent_kind = r.item_kind
       AND c.parent_num = r.item_num
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_sets
FROM sets s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM reachable r
    WHERE r.root_kind = 'set'
      AND r.root_num = s.set_num
      AND r.item_kind = 'minifig'
      AND r.item_num = 'fig-007579'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM reachable r
    WHERE r.root_kind = 'set'
      AND r.root_num = s.set_num
      AND r.item_kind = 'part'
      AND r.item_num = '48336'
);

        parent_num,

    FROM u_composition

current_edges AS (
    SELECT
        c.parent_kind,
        c.parent_num,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN current_version v
        ON c.parent_kind = v.parent_kind
       AND c.parent_num = v.parent_num
       AND c.version = v.max_version
    WHERE c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
),
sets_2024 AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree t
        ON s.theme_id = t.id
    WHERE s.year = 2024

exploded_contents AS (
    SELECT
        set_num AS root_set_num,
        'set' AS item_kind,
        set_num AS item_num,

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ec.root_set_num,
        e.child_kind,
        e.child_num,
        ec.qty_multiplier * e.qty::BIGINT
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_edges e
        ON e.parent_kind = ec.item_kind
       AND e.parent_num = ec.item_num
    WHERE ec.item_kind = 'set'

WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT i.set_num AS item, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) v
      ON v.set_num = i.set_num
     AND v.max_version = i.version
),
target_color AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM colors
    WHERE name = 'Black'
),
containing(item) AS (
    SELECT ci.item
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip
      ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN target_color tc
      ON tc.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '23186'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE

    UNION

    SELECT parent.item
    FROM containing child
    JOIN (
        SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS item
        FROM inventory_sets
        UNION ALL
        SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item
        FROM inventory_minifigs
    ) relation
      ON relation.item = child.item
    JOIN current_inv parent
      ON parent.inventory_id = relation.inventory_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num) AS set_count
FROM sets s
JOIN containing c
  ON c.item = s.set_num;

WITH RECURSIVE current_edges AS (
    SELECT
        parent_kind,
        parent_num,
        child_kind,
        child_num,
        color_id,
        is_spare
    FROM u_composition
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY parent_kind, parent_num
        ORDER BY version DESC
    ) = 1
),
target_parents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.parent_kind,
        e.parent_num
    FROM current_edges e
    JOIN colors c
        ON c.id = e.color_id
    WHERE e.child_kind = 'part'
      AND e.child_num = '23186'
      AND c.name = 'Black'
      AND e.is_spare = FALSE
),
ancestors(node_kind, node_num, path) AS (
    SELECT
        parent_kind,
        parent_num,
        [parent_kind || ':' || parent_num]
    FROM target_parents

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.parent_kind,
        e.parent_num,
        list_append(a.path, e.parent_kind || ':' || e.parent_num)
    FROM ancestors a
    JOIN current_edges e
        ON e.child_kind = a.node_kind
       AND e.child_num = a.node_num
    WHERE NOT list_contains(
        a.path,
        e.parent_kind || ':' || e.parent_num
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_num) AS containing_sets
FROM ancestors
WHERE node_kind = 'set';

1. Build the list of current inventory IDs by selecting the highest inventory version for each set or minifig.
2. Select 2016 sets whose theme is `Architecture` or is a sub-theme of it at any depth.
3. Recursively traverse nested sets and minifigs, allowing only their current inventories.

WITH RECURSIVE current_inv AS (
    SELECT
        set_num AS item,
        id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY set_num
        ORDER BY version DESC, id DESC
    ) = 1
),
container_edge AS (
    SELECT
        iset.set_num AS child_item,
        ci.item AS parent_item
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset
        ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ifig.fig_num AS child_item,
        ci.item AS parent_item
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs ifig
        ON ifig.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
),
direct_hit AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ci.item
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip
        ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN colors co
        ON co.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '39793'
      AND co.name = 'White'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
),
hit AS (
    SELECT
        item,
        list_value(item) AS path
    FROM direct_hit

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ce.parent_item,
        list_append(h.path, ce.parent_item)
    FROM hit h
    JOIN container_edge ce
        ON ce.child_item = h.item
    WHERE NOT list_contains(h.path, ce.parent_item)
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT h.item) AS set_count
FROM hit h
JOIN sets s
    ON s.set_num = h.item;
